Package com.duck.model.type

package com.duck.model.type
  • Class
    Description
    Account
    Represents a user account with authentication credentials, a monetary balance, and an associated AccountConfig (theme, currency, avatar).
    AccountConfig
    Stores user preference settings for an Account: avatar image path, color theme mode (DARK / LIGHT), and currency (USD / EUR / EGP).
    AppSettings
    Holds all shared enumerations used throughout the application: data persistence keys, theme mode, currency, transaction type, operation result messages, and PropertyChangeEvent types for budgets, goals, accounts, and transactions.

    Period
    Represents a time period defined by a start and end LocalDate.
    Range
    Represents a numeric range between a minimum and maximum float value.
    ReportConfig
    Holds configuration for a single report entry associating a category name with a calculated percentage value.
    SavingGoal
    Represents a user-defined saving goal.
    Transaction
    Represents a single financial transaction (income or expense).
    TransactionConfig
    Configuration object used to define the parameters for querying or creating a Transaction.
